name: minGRU_minKron_common_LM_pilot_v1
status: proposed defaults; freeze after hardware and data qualification, before training

data.corpus: FineWeb via the pinned speedrun data pipeline
data.tokenizer: GPT-2, identical token IDs for all arms
data.split_rule: document-disjoint; publish exact shard, document, token and checksum manifests

training.no_weight_decay: embedding/tied head, norms, biases and explicit recurrence decay parameters
training.schedule: cosine to 0.1 of selected peak LR
training.state_storage: FP32 for both recurrent arms initially
training.state_policy: reset at independent windows and document boundaries; full BPTT within each window

selection: LR selected on development only; final fixed-token checkpoint for confirmation
timing: record full training-loop wall time and separate setup/compile/preprocessing time
hardware_gate: same GPU type/count for comparative timings; CPU-only sessions prepare and verify only
